title: Add RAG templates, agent/tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: Provide reproducible RAG templates and agent/tool-calling examples to accelerate developer onboarding and reduce support questions. This PR adds opinionated RAG prompt templates, a set of small agent examples (tool-calling + function-calling), and quickstart pages + sidebar updates for the docs site. The goal is to give engineers copy-pasteable examples that demonstrate common patterns (document ingestion, retrieval + rerank, agent using external tools, and safe function/tool calls) and to link these into the Console quickstarts.

What this changes (high level):
- examples/rag-templates/: three templates (faq-style, conversational, and summarization) plus README with usage notes and recommended chunking/embedding settings.
- examples/agents/tool-calling/: minimal Node/Python examples showing how to register tools, perform safe tool calls, and handle tool errors. Includes a test harness for local runs.
- docs/guides/rag.md: new guide that walks through RAG architecture, config snippets for Redwood runtime, and recommended perf profiles for different latency/cost tradeoffs.
- docs/quickstarts/agents.md: quickstart with step-by-step for building an agent-backed assistant using the examples; includes a 'Deploy to Redwood' callout.
- docs/config/sidebar.json: added new top-level entries for RAG and Agents quickstarts so they appear in the docs nav.
- small copy/typo fixes across docs referenced by the quickstarts.

Checklist:
- [x] Add example code (Node + Python) for agent/tool-calling
- [x] Add RAG prompt templates and README guidance
- [x] Add docs quickstart + guide pages with code snippets and config examples
- [x] Update docs sidebar and top-level TOC
- [x] Add CI tests to run the example harness (lightweight smoke)

Commits summary: 4 commits that progressively add templates, examples, docs, then CI fixes after initial docs build failure. No runtime code changes.

Usage notes and forward guidance:
- The RAG templates include explicit placeholders for embeddings config (model, chunk_size, overlap) and recommended cache TTLs for prefix caching.
- Agent examples show both Redwood function-style tool-calling and a more explicit wiring for external HTTP/SDK tools. We call out security practices (short-lived API keys, KMS for secrets, and safe serialization).
- The docs guide contains a short troubleshooting section (embedding low-similarity, cold KV cache) and links to perf canary and eval harness for regression testing.

Related tasks: ENG-4212 (RAG quickstarts), ENG-4380 (agent examples), PM-102 (docs launch checklist).

Notes about CI: initial push failed docs build due to a relative link in sidebar; fixed in second commit. Example harness runs as a lightweight smoke test in CI (does not require GPUs).

Merge notes: docs-only + examples; approved by reviewers and squashed into a single commit on merge.
